The studio

Forty-one people,
one building,
no handoffs.

Architects, quantity surveyors, structural engineers and site managers sit on the same floor in Marbella. When a detail changes, the cost plan changes the same afternoon — not six weeks later in a variation order.

We take on eleven houses a year. That number is not a marketing position; it is the maximum our directors can personally attend site for, every fortnight, for the life of the build.

  4. SubstructureRock anchors · 14° slopeInvisible, unrepairable, and the whole thing sits on it.

How it runs

Five stages.
Fixed price at
stage three.

After stage three our number does not move unless you move it. That is a contract clause, not a promise.

01

01

Listen & survey

2–6 weeks

Site, soil, sun, access, planning constraints. We write you a feasibility note that includes what we think you should not build.

02

Design & model

3–6 months

Concept through to consent. Cost planned in parallel, updated every two weeks, never at the end.

03

Fix the number

4–6 weeks

A single lump-sum contract with a priced schedule of every element. After this point our price does not move unless you move it.

04

Build

12–30 months

Our site teams. Fortnightly director visits, weekly photo report, live cost and programme dashboard.

05

Hand over & hold

24 months

Full commissioning, a two-year defects period we actually staff, and a building manual you can hand to the next owner.

Materials

We specify six things.
We know all six.

A short palette, from suppliers we have used for over a decade, detailed the same way every time. That is why our snagging lists are short.

Limestone

Alicante, ES

Honed, 40 mm

Smoked oak

Jutland, DK

Single-log joinery

Board concrete

Cast in situ

Sawn-board formwork

Patinated brass

Milan, IT

Mashrabiya & ironmongery

Lime plaster

Provence, FR

Three-coat, hand-floated

Low-iron glass

Padua, IT

Structural, up to 42 mm
